description: Every Prospeo endpoint, plus a credit-aware local cache, bulk CSV pipelines, and lookalike search no other Prospeo tool ships.
auth_description:
Get your API key from https://app.prospeo.io/api-keys and export it:
  export PROSPEO_API_KEY=...
The CLI sends it as the X-KEY header on every request.

novel_features.name: Offline FTS over enrichment cache
novel_features.description: Search every contact or company you've previously enriched without spending a credit.

novel_features.name: Lifetime-dupe-aware cache
novel_features.description: Predict which rows in a CSV would be free Prospeo lifetime-duplicate hits before you spend credits.

novel_features.name: Credit pre-flight + max-cost guard
novel_features.description: Estimate the credit cost of a bulk job and refuse to run if it exceeds the budget or remaining balance.

novel_features.name: Bulk cost simulator
novel_features.description: Show projected credits, dupe-hit ratio, and ETA before sending any rows.

novel_features.name: Credit burn timeline
novel_features.description: Daily burn rate and projected runway from snapshots of /account-information.

novel_features.name: Lookalike from seed
novel_features.description: Find companies (or people) similar to a seed by auto-deriving industry, size, tech-stack, and location filters from an enriched seed.

novel_features.name: Search-then-enrich pipeline
novel_features.description: Run search-person with filters, walk pages, enrich each hit (verified-only), cache everything, write CSV.

novel_features.name: Dedup-aware CSV merge
novel_features.description: Skip rows already in an existing enriched CSV so re-runs are incremental and cheap.

novel_features.name: Per-plan rate limiter
novel_features.description: Plan-aware token bucket that slows down before tripping Prospeo's 429s.

novel_features.name: ICP fit scorer
novel_features.description: Score every enriched row against a YAML ICP spec (titles, sizes, geos, tech, seniority) and emit a score column with reasons.

novel_features.name: Spend-attribution ledger
novel_features.description: Report spend per CSV source, per campaign tag, or per day from the local enrichments + csv_jobs + account_snapshots ledger.
